description: A contract-aware query (smd query --contract) is a content-bearing route (definitions, Routes) whose requested scope is the blocks its selector matches. Shown(r) is the matched blocks, and each sits in its section, so a constraint whose section encloses a match applies (L2). The view carries the agent blocks and dangers of the document (L1), the document-scoped rules, the rules of the sections around a match, the rules whose applies-to names a match, the prerequisite closure and the rules of a prerequisite's section (L2, L3), and lists what it cannot carry or resolve (L3). Matched blocks are listed in mustAppear by hand, since the oracle does not evaluate selectors.

requests.name: query RCUT carries the rules, the prerequisite and the protected blocks of the document
brief query RCUT carries the same blocks
a query matching blocks in two sections carries the rules of both
a query of a prerequisite carries the rules of its own section and the global ones
a query whose match has a missing prerequisite lists it, and the rule with a lost target applies unplaced
a query whose match needs a block hidden from agents withholds it and lists it as hidden
